questionStem: Finish these three sentences using what the source says about jobs for rural youth.

taskBody.instructions: Use a word or a short phrase, up to 120 characters each.

starters.text: Many factory jobs are hard for rural youth to take because...
Young people who stay in their home area often give up...
Suitable jobs for rural youth depend on training, local businesses and...

challengeCandidates.label: TN1
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When the first sentence is marked or does not use the source
challengeCandidates.message: Which sentence in the source is about factory jobs? What does it say about the workers?

challengeCandidates.label: TN2
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When the second sentence is marked or does not use the source
challengeCandidates.message: Find the paragraph about staying in the home area. What does it say comes with that path?

challengeCandidates.label: TN3
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When the third sentence is marked or does not use the source
challengeCandidates.message: Read the last paragraph of the source. What else does it say jobs depend on?

challengeCandidates.label: Fallback
challengeCandidates.whenShownForTeacher: When none of the above applies
challengeCandidates.message: Read your answers again. Which part of the source does each one rest on?

feedback.text: The source links factory jobs to skills not yet trained, staying home to lower income and fewer chances to learn a trade, and suitable jobs to training, local businesses and better living conditions.
